name: MoveManagementPlanner
tagline: Plan office moves, restacks and MAC churn – waves, crates, IT tasks and seat conflicts in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete move/add/change planning app for Power Apps and Power Pages: dashboard, wave board with drag and drop and crate/people limits, move list with bulk actions, schedule grid with blackout dates, conflict checker (double-booked or still-occupied seats, swaps, missing destinations, overfull waves) with quick fixes, IT checklists and a move status workflow from Planned to Verified.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 51-move restack
Crate, people and daily move limits
Seat conflict detection with quick fixes
Status workflow with reasons and confirmations
Bulk status, wave, date and coordinator
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
